registration.statement: For every generated odd denominator beyond the One, pairing a positive residue with the binary Fold cannot acquire the denominator's factor and therefore cannot reach structural absence. The finite positive residue support forces a first return, so each such vacuum mode remains on an exact live cycle.
registration.title: Perpetually live odd-denominator vacuum recurrence
